```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
data <- readr::read_csv(
  "pages/gallery/data/data_data/tbl-01-openwashdata-datasets.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
pub <- data |> filter(status == "published")
n_pub <- nrow(pub)
n_loc <- n_distinct(pub$location)
first_year <- min(as.integer(format(pub$date_published, "%Y")), na.rm = TRUE)
latest <- pub |> arrange(desc(date_published)) |> slice_head(n = 3)
pkg_links <- paste(
  sprintf("[%s](%s)", latest$pkg_name, latest$link_pkg_website),
  collapse = ", "
)
```

<span class="owd-step">01 Why</span>

## Open data for water, sanitation and hygiene

<p class="owd-lead">openwashdata is a community that publishes WASH datasets as documented, citable R data packages, and teaches the skills to do it.</p>

::: {#subscribe}

<span class="owd-step">02 Data</span>

## `r n_pub` datasets, one workflow

<p class="owd-lead">Every dataset is an R data package with a website, a data dictionary, a license and a citation. The newest: `r pkg_links`.</p>

::: {.owd-actions}
[Browse the datasets](pages/gallery/data/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
:::
::: {.owd-screen-visual}
::: {.owd-chart}
<p class="owd-chart-title">Data packages published per year</p>

```{ojs}
rawc = FileAttachment("pages/gallery/data/data_data/tbl-01-openwashdata-datasets.csv").csv({typed: false})
yearsc = rawc
  .filter(d => d.status === "published" && d.date_published && d.date_published !== "NA")
  .map(d => ({year: d.date_published.slice(0, 4)}))
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 520),
  height: 240,
  marginLeft: 30,
  marginTop: 24,
  style: {fontFamily: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, sans-serif", fontSize: 13, background: "transparent"},
  x: {label: null, tickSize: 0, type: "band"},
  y: {label: null, grid: true, ticks: 4},
  marks: [
    Plot.barY(yearsc, Plot.groupX({y: "count"}, {x: "year", fill: "#5b195b", tip: true})),
    Plot.text(yearsc, Plot.groupX({y: "count", text: "count"}, {x: "year", dy: -8, fill: "#1e1e1e", fontWeight: 700})),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
})
```
